s2.ptxt: Apply engine oil to the oil pump relief valve.
Insert the oil pump relief valve into the valve installation hole of the oil pump cover and check that it falls smoothly under its own weight.
Apply engine oil to the oil pump rotor set.
Install the oil pump rotor set to the timing chain (belt) cover with the marks facing the oil pump cover side, and check that the rotors turn smoothly.

s3.ptxt: Using a feeler gauge, measure the clearance between the driven rotor and drive rotor.

atten4.ptxt: If the clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the oil pump rotor set.

s3.ptxt: Using a precision straightedge and feeler gauge, measure the clearance between the oil pump rotor set and timing chain (belt) cover.

atten4.ptxt: If the clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the oil pump rotor set and timing chain (belt) cover.

s3.ptxt: Using a feeler gauge, measure the clearance between the driven rotor and chain cover.

atten4.ptxt: If the clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the oil pump rotor set and timing chain (belt) cover.
